CREATE TABLE "public"."category" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "isInternal" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "measurementMode" text NOT NULL,
  "nameAr" text NOT NULL,
  "nameFr" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "category_internal_inactive_1a4cd3b7" CHECK (NOT "isInternal" OR NOT "isActive"),
  CONSTRAINT "category_measurement_mode_812f2fa6" CHECK ("measurementMode" IN ('WEIGHT', 'VOLUME', 'WEIGHT_AND_VOLUME', 'FLEXIBLE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."subcategory" (
  "categoryId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "nameAr" text NOT NULL,
  "nameFr" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

UPDATE public.product p SET "categoryId" = COALESCE((
          SELECT c.id FROM public.category c WHERE NOT c."isInternal" AND p.category IN (c."nameAr", c."nameFr")
          AND (c."measurementMode" = 'FLEXIBLE'
            OR (c."measurementMode" = 'WEIGHT' AND p."storageUnit" IN ('G','KG') AND p."saleUnit" IN ('G','KG'))
            OR (c."measurementMode" = 'VOLUME' AND p."storageUnit" IN ('ML','L') AND p."saleUnit" IN ('ML','L'))
            OR (c."measurementMode" = 'WEIGHT_AND_VOLUME' AND p."storageUnit" IN ('G','KG','ML','L') AND p."saleUnit" IN ('G','KG','ML','L')))
          ), (SELECT id FROM public.category WHERE "isInternal")) WHERE p."categoryId" IS NULL
